name: Render
long_description:
Render is an AI CMO that runs a business's marketing on autopilot.

We're at $1.7M ARR, growing 100% month over month, with 1,000+ paying businesses.

Render makes the ads, launches the campaigns, and improves them every day. It covers Meta, Google and YouTube ads, cold email, direct mail, and TV commercials. Most small businesses can't afford a marketing team, and agencies charge thousands a month to run one or two channels. Render runs all of them for a fraction of the price. Owners connect their accounts and set a budget, and Render does the rest.
one_liner: AI CMO that puts marketing on autopilot

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: I’m building Render, which is at $1.7M ARR and growing 100% month over month. Before Render, I grew Bloom to $3M+ ARR and pitched it on Shark Tank (Season 17). In high school, I worked at NASA and graduated valedictorian with $200K+ in scholarships from Lockheed Martin, Amazon, and others. I then attended UCLA on a full-ride Regents Scholarship and interned at Amazon. I’m also a Z Fellow.
